end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere with two attempts.
Matched everyday objects to 3D shapes in 3 out of 3 attempts.
Explained that a football is a sphere and a circle is flat.
Explained dice as a cube, brick as a cuboid, and hat or ice cream as a cone.
Teach-back was not passed; requested pictures and a game.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes and matching them with everyday objects. Ishita used useful features such as “flat,” “pointy,” “all sides same,” and “long” to explain the shapes. No shape mix-up was recorded; the circle-versus-sphere distinction was stated correctly later in the lesson. At home, ask Ishita to find one cube, cuboid, cone, cylinder, and sphere and describe one feature of each.
